title: agent-core 0.7.80: tasks get due dates, work states and links; Tasks API (T115 + T104)
head: t115-tasks
body:
agent-core 0.7.80 adds T115 tasks with the T104 Tasks API folded in.

## What
- T104 adds the Pipelines (tasks) API: list, filter and sort; create, update, mark done and reopen; auth on every route; refuse ticks on a locked step.
- T115 adds due_date (ISO date, default sort), work_state (open/in_progress/waiting/blocked; never a completion path), and up to 8 task_links (then/waiting_on/blocked_by; explicit pick only; no self link or cycles).
- map_status is server-derived: done only from completed_at, else work_state. Reusing a mutation id with different content raises MutationConflict.
- Trusted chat picks use plain words. Mark done is for plain tasks only.
- Files: src/anorak/pipeline_model.py, memory/pipelines.py, pipelines.py, chat_tools.py, local_service_adapters.py, service_cli.py, plain_words.py, local_service.py, docs/local-service.md. Tests: test_pipeline_model/store/runtime/chat/injection/endpoints/gate_sweep, test_plain_words, test_t115_release.

## Safety
- A gated or ask-first step cannot be completed, unlocked or skipped by due_date, work_state, task_links, mark done or reopen. Only the runner's existing ask-first Yes unlocks; skill.yaml risky_steps/always_ask decide locks.
- Ticks stay in her private drawer, never To Do/Planner writes (#373).
- Chat turns and summaries travel as their own messages, never system text (#73).

## Checks
<!-- swarm:checks -->
Local (rebased on main b1b24f3 = #118 + #119): `uv run pytest -q` 4916 passed, 6 skipped, 1 xfailed · `ruff check .` clean · `mypy --strict src` clean (105 files).

## Mutation check
- M1 mark_done skips the plain-task check: KILLED.
- M2 plain resolver ignores a gated-but-done step: KILLED (gate test added).
- M3 tick ignores the lock: KILLED.
- M4 chat turns moved into system text: KILLED.
- M5 summary moved into system text: KILLED.

## Integration with #118 (follow a running skill)
- Followed runs now keep `pipeline_id`/`pipeline_step_id`, so the step is marked done only after the runner's matching Yes.
- Braden (2026-10-11): keep #118 — a followed run's Yes card waits as needs_you after its timer; the step stays locked until a real Yes. The expiry test case now asserts that.
- Post-rebase gate mutants: G1b followed submit drops the binding KILLED; G2 followed approval auto-yes KILLED; G3 mark_done skips plain check KILLED; G4 plain check ignores gated steps KILLED; G1 plain (non-followed) submit drops the binding SURVIVED (fails safe: step never marked done; no test drives the non-followed path now); G5 plain check ignores locked status SURVIVED (equivalent: a locked step is always gated).

## Windows access violation fix
- Two Windows CI runs crashed with a native access violation while the pipeline observer did private-drawer I/O from the skill worker thread. `loop_storage.py` now declares exact ctypes argtypes/restype for every Windows API it calls (LocalFree restype was missing, among others), serializes its Windows helpers behind one RLock, and keeps CreateFileW's error before cleanup. Root cause is a hypothesis (no truncating dereference proven); proof is a green Windows matrix. Every refusal is unchanged (26 StorageError paths, ancestry and ACL checks). New tests: prototype coverage and an 8×50 threaded stress test.

## Store read speed
- Reading one task used to re-read every task file and re-check every link (61 file reads for one lookup; >30s on Windows CI in the history-caps test). Now one lookup = 2 reads; link checks run only when links are written; one snapshot per operation (never cached across calls). Durable-write failures still map to 503. Link rules mutation-checked after the change: cycle check off KILLED, unknown target allowed KILLED, link validation never called KILLED.

## Version
0.7.80 on top of #118 (0.7.78) and #119 (0.7.79), both merged.

## Needs Braden
Yes: ask-first gate paths. HELD for his typed merge. Pairs with the desktop T115 PR (desktop pins this core after merge).
